title: Patch: the Play screen holds every mode on one screen, online first
thread:
**Issue #1578 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1578: Patch: the Play screen holds every mode on one screen, online first
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

Part of #1576 (the tavern menu overhaul). Read the tracker's Goals first.

Blocked by #1577

## What

The screen behind the **Play** door (`apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` today, or its successor) is the one place every play mode starts from:

- **Online play is the centre**: the big, first action is finding an online match (quick / ranked, whatever online queues exist), with the player's rank and the deck they'll queue with right there.
- Around it, smaller: practice against the AI (and its custom / tutorial variants), co-op (duos, together), series, conquest, inviting a friend, hotseat if it is offered to players, replays if they belong here. Every mode a player can start today is reachable from here; the planner lists them from the code.
- Modes that move here from elsewhere are removed from where they were, with their old URLs redirected (CLAUDE.md rule 13).
- A live game in progress (the game banner) still offers the way back.

## Done when

- One screen, no page scrolling, on desktop and on a phone (a phone may stack, but it still fits).
- Online play is visibly the primary action; the rest read as secondary.
- `play.test.tsx` (and the tests of each moved entry) prove every mode is reachable from Play and that each old entry point now leads here or redirects.
- e2e specs that started a mode the old way are updated.
```

# Draft plan for #1578 (planner, in progress; design settled, writing final)

## Decisions (settled)
- `/play` (play.tsx) is the hub. Landing Play door -> `paths.play` (was `/practice`, R1577000).
- main.tsx `/play`: `if (!signedIn) return <PlayRoute token={null} />;` (signedIn = readSession() !== null, already in App).
  A session (even stale) still meets Gated as before -> gate.test stale-token test stays valid.
- PlayRoute({token: string|null}): null -> SignedOutPlay (no reads), else OnlinePlay (existing body renamed).
- Hub layout: root `app-shell tavern lobby play-screen play-hub` testid play-screen; hero (h1 JackiOh + title "Play", lead removed);
  `.play-layout` = [section.play-online (testid play-online, h2 "Play online"): RankPanel (minus replays link), setup section (unchanged),
  queue section (unchanged)] + [div.play-side: nav.play-ways (testid play-ways, aria "More ways to play": Practice /practice (play-practice),
  Card creator /creator (play-creator), Play together /together (play-together), Replays /replays (play-replays)); room panel (unchanged)].
  Keep regions "How do you want to play?" and "Find a match" (play.test + qa-v020 tests use them).
- Signed out: play-online--signed-out with "Online play is invite-only for now: you’ll need an invite code after signing up." (existing i18n) + a.button-primary Sign in (play-sign-in) -> /login; side = ways only.
- No tutorial tile (?lesson= would end a saved practice game, R765); Practice note names the tutorial. No hotseat tile (dev only). No LiveGameBanner on /play (lobby watch already takes a live player there).
- practice.tsx: remove #1577 "More ways to play" nav + `.practice-more-ways` css; lobby BackLinks -> paths.play.
- CSS scoped `.tavern.play-screen.play-hub` (series.tsx shares .play-screen!). Root height 100dvh overflow hidden; setup panel scrolls inside.
- New ruling R1578000 (amends R1577000, edits §9.5 Play-together bullet). proven_in: play.test, landing.test, practice.test, gate.test, shell-gate.test.
- Tests to fix: landing.test CTAS/R1577000 door test; landing-together B54 door test; practice.test #1577; shell-gate (#479 /play, R767 link, B35);
  sign-in-landing it.each (paths.play -> paths.together); e2e 14 (B37 href/click, #479 visit /decks).
- New component spec e2e/cypress/component/play-screen.cy.tsx (cypress verify works here; chrome at /usr/bin/google-chrome).
- i18n new: landing note, 4 way notes. Reuse: "Play", "Play online", "Practice", "Card creator", "Play together", "Replays", "More ways to play", "Sign in".
